correctness.rationale: The statement is for all n>=1,k>=0 on diagonal integral MH_{k,k} of graph-metric Q_n, not the torsion of MH itself or of a topological quotient. K2 alternating paths generate two copies of Z in each diagonal degree; natural integral Kunneth gives a complete basis of 2^n times weak compositions. The shuffle chains are cycles: deleting a vertex from two different successive flips cancels with the transposed word; equal consecutive flips backtrack and cannot be deleted preserving length. The inversion parity for permutation sigma is sum_{i<j,sigma(i)>sigma(j)} a_i a_j. Free translation coinvariants leave a signed S_n-permutation module on weak compositions. Each partition orbit yields Z or Z/2, with negative stabilizer precisely from repeated odd parts; all zero and even repeated parts have positive swap sign. For n=3, even k, odd j in (j,j,k-2j) yield floor((k+2)/4) distinct torsion orbits. Independent small n,k partition counting and exact inspected chain differential/transposition checks corroborate, not replace, the universal Kunneth-and-stabilizer proof.
